designSystem.name: Sarah Constellation

inspiration.name: Your workplace has the answer. Just ask Dala for it.

adaptation.fr: Une constellation personnelle reliant Madagascar, les Alpes, le triathlon et la finance sur une scène noire, lumineuse et très épurée.
adaptation.en: A personal constellation connecting Madagascar, the Alps, triathlon and finance on a luminous, highly restrained black stage.

principles: Pure black is an active canvas, not a fallback background.
Scale, whitespace and motion create hierarchy; cards and shadows do not.
Electric Iris is reserved for primary actions and active states.
Saffron Spark highlights effort, progress and key narrative moments.
Personal colors appear inside particle visualizations, not across the interface chrome.
One principal visual and one principal action maximum per viewport.

typography.fontFamily: PP Neue Montreal, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

layout.cardPolicy: Avoid filled cards; content floats directly on the void canvas.

primaryButton.usage: One primary action maximum per viewport.

ghostLink.underline: on hover or keyboard focus only

sectionHeadline.layout: oversized headline paired with light supporting copy

scrollBehaviour: Fade ambient particles in before text enters.
Connect active narrative nodes progressively as the user scrolls.
Morph the hero constellation between personal chapters without abrupt cuts.
Keep essential content readable before animation completes.
motion.reducedMotion: Replace particle drift and morphing with static constellations and opacity transitions below 200ms.

accessibility.canvasFallback: Every visualization must include an equivalent text summary.
accessibility.interaction: All hover interactions must also work with keyboard focus and touch.

concept.fr: Une île de Madagascar composée de particules se déploie en trajectoire ascendante, puis devient crête alpine. Les points violets incarnent la finance, les points ambre l’endurance et les points verts l’apprentissage.
concept.en: A particle-built Madagascar silhouette unfolds into an ascending trail and then an Alpine ridge. Violet points represent finance, amber points endurance and green points learning.

visualizations.interaction: Morph between states according to hero progress and the first story-card entries; pointer movement creates gentle depth only.

textAlternative.fr: De Madagascar aux Alpes, une trajectoire relie endurance, apprentissage et marchés financiers.
textAlternative.en: From Madagascar to the Alps, one trajectory connects endurance, learning and financial markets.

visualizations.interaction: The active node expands, reveals its bilingual copy and softly repels nearby ambient particles.
visualizations.mobileBehaviour: Transform the graph into a vertical connected timeline while preserving colors and node order.

visualEncoding.nodeSize: number of bullet points, used only for visual balance
visualEncoding.nodeColor: #8052ff for current experience; #9a9a9a for previous experiences
visualEncoding.milestones: highlight values float near the relevant narrative, without inventing links not present in the data

visualizations.interaction: Selecting a node reveals role, location, dates and bullet points in a borderless adjacent text block.
Scroll rotates emphasis from swim to bike to run; the three paths finally merge into one finish-line trajectory.
visualizations.dataPolicy: Do not display invented distances, times or percentages. Use only values present elsewhere in the profile.

visualizations.interaction: Hover, focus or tap expands one cluster into readable labels; labels collapse back into particles on exit.
visualizations.fallback: Render the existing skills lists when canvas or WebGL is unavailable.

headline: J’ai traversé les chiffres pour entendre le monde,
Cherchant sous les bilans une rumeur profonde.
Le hasard, vieux Cyclope, épiait mon passage,
D’un œil — c’était assez — pour mesurer l’ouvrage.
Je n’ai volé nul pain pour conquérir ma place,
J’ai seulement couru, nagé, codé sans grâce.
Puis l’avenir s’ouvrit sans donner ses raisons,
Madagascar nourrit mon goût des horizons.
Mes parents ont choisi les monts avec audace,
Le ski répondit par son silence de glace.
fr.summary: Voici donc mon parcours — encore à ses débuts.

headline: I crossed the halls of numbers to hear the world speak,
Beneath the balance sheets, I sought its murmurs deep.
Chance, the old Cyclops, watched me passing on my way;
One eye — and that was plenty — appraised the work that day.
I stole no loaf of bread to earn myself a place;
I ran, I swam, I coded — seldom blessed with grace.
Then future opened wide, but never told me why;
Madagascar taught my eyes to seek broader skies.
My parents chose the peaks, as daring parents would;
Skiing answered in silence, as only ice could.
en.summary: Let me tell you the story of my journey so far — still in its early chapters.

summary.fr: Prime Brokerage, exécution, clearing et financement pour une clientèle institutionnelle internationale.
summary.en: Prime Brokerage, execution, clearing and financing for international institutional clients.

fr: Pricing de plus de 15 milliards d’euros de portefeuilles institutionnels avec analyses d’Initial Margin, de VaR et de stress tests.
Pilotage d’une migration de comptes ETD et OTC vers BlackRock Aladdin, des jalons jusqu’au Go-Live.
Contribution à l’onboarding de bout en bout : KYC, due diligence, lignes de crédit et validation des commissions.
Préparation de présentations clients sur l’OTC Clearing, le Repo Clearing et le financement.
en: Priced more than €15 billion of institutional portfolios using Initial Margin, VaR and stress-test analysis.
Led an ETD and OTC account migration to BlackRock Aladdin, from milestones through Go-Live.
Contributed to end-to-end onboarding: KYC, due diligence, credit lines and commission validation.
Prepared client presentations on OTC Clearing, Repo Clearing and financing.
